Not a résumé.
A timeline.

Every project sharpened a different blade. Drag, swipe or use the arrows.

2021 - 2022

First paid creator collab → weekly vlogs

Where it started - cutting weekly vlogs for a mid-size creator. Learned the fundamentals: organizing hours of messy footage, finding the story in the chaos, and delivering on a fixed weekly clock.

2022 - 2023

Agency editor → Supervisor

Joined an agency as an editor, then was promoted to supervisor after two months. The role shifted from cutting individual projects to reviewing edits, guiding editors and keeping quality consistent across a busy client pipeline.

2023 - Present

Freelance editor → 30+ clients

Running my own desk full-time - YouTubers, brands and agencies across long-form, shorts and ads. The shift was from making videos look good to building edits around pace, clarity and what keeps viewers watching. Every project became a sharper lesson in shaping raw footage into a stronger viewing experience.

Next

Your project → the next chapter

Taking on a limited number of ongoing project slots for creators and agencies who upload consistently. If that's you, the next card in this timeline could have your name on it.

Questions I hear
on repeat.

YouTube videos, documentaries, podcast episodes, vlogs, brand films, ads, Reels, Shorts and TikToks. If it moves, I can cut it.

Share your footage and reference style → I cut a first draft → you send notes → revisions → final export in whatever formats you need. Simple and async.

Footage (Drive, Dropbox or WeTransfer all work), any brand/style references, and a rough idea of the outcome you're after. I'll handle the rest.

Turnaround depends on the scope, footage and complexity. Rush work can be arranged when the schedule allows.

Yes — I regularly act as white-label overflow capacity for agencies. You keep the client relationship; I keep your deadlines safe.

Two rounds of revisions are included by default. Additional rounds can be added if a project needs more exploration.

Premiere Pro is my main NLE, with After Effects for motion work and DaVinci Resolve when a project needs a dedicated grading workflow.
